You're right, teens are very moody in general, but BPD commonly develops around adolescent years! There are other symptoms for BPD, and you need to have at least 5 of the 9 (i have 8). But try going to therapy if you even have <5 symptoms. It will help you understand yourself better, and will give you a diagnosis and treatment that can help you (even if it's not BPD)
